description.blurb: Comet C/2010 X1 (Elenin) is an Oort cloud comet discovered on December 10, 2010.
description.more: Comet Elenin was hit by a coronal mass ejection from the sun and started disintegrating in August of 2011, and as of mid-October 2011 was not visible even using large ground-based telescopes.
